label: Clear
cues: Stable constraints; cause and effect self-evident; established practice demonstrably applies
posture: Use established verified practice within its bounds; check outcome
disconfirmers: Novel conditions or conflicting evidence; familiar symptom without causal confirmation

label: Complicated
cues: Cause and effect discoverable through expertise or analysis; governing constraints
posture: Investigate and compare explanations using evidence and relevant expertise
disconfirmers: Interaction changes the situation in ways analysis alone cannot predict; constraints ineffective

label: Complex
cues: Enabling constraints; entangled interactions; patterns learned through interaction rather than linear prediction
posture: Propose bounded hypothesis probes with owner limits observation stop/rollback and review; execute only with authority
disconfirmers: Merely unfamiliar or missing evidence; stable reproducible causal mechanism available to analysis
keywords: emergence entanglement interaction learning probe uncertainty

label: Chaotic
cues: Effective constraints absent; turbulence prevents stable analysis in the affected context
posture: Only with explicit human authorization for the specific containment scope stabilize minimally then reassess; otherwise escalate without acting
disconfirmers: Urgency alone; disagreement or ignorance without evidence of ineffective constraints

label: Confusion
cues: Context unclear or mixed; insufficient evidence to distinguish applicable approaches
posture: Decompose into coherent concerns and gather evidence; keep posture provisional
disconfirmers: Evidence supports a bounded concern in another domain; lack of knowledge is not itself chaos
keywords: mixed unclear decompose evidence aporia confused disorder
